text:
maria: Heads up: canary in eu-west is spiking eviction backoffs after latest chart bump. Observed ~3x pod restarts in last 10m.

Deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout 2026-03-21T09:40 started for chart payments-service@2.4.0-alpha (subchart billing@1.2.1) - prow: canary-eu-west

josh: Is this the subchart bind change we flagged in release notes? I thought we pinned billing to 1.2.0.

maria: We pinned top-level chart but values override in tenant overlay promoted 1.2.1 for billing. That override slipped in PR #5126.

olivia: Confirming: the override flips `billing.replicas` and `billing.nodeSelector`. Might be scheduling to smaller nodes -> OOM/killing.

samir: Suggesting pause canary, rollback subchart to 1.2.0 and run quick smoke. Who can approve?

leah: I'm on-call, ok to pause. What's scope of rollback? Hotpatch subchart or pin values?

josh: Prefer hotpatch subchart in chartmuseum and rebind overlay: publish billing@1.2.0 -> chartmuseum, then trigger deploybot hotpatch. Avoid re-running full promotion window.

Deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary paused by @leah at 4910001240. All new canary traffic redirected to stable.

maria: I'll open hotpatch PR now with `chart.lock` change and values rollback. Small note: release notes should mention tenant override that caused it.

olivia: Add rollback rationale: 'nodeSelector drift caused smaller instance scheduling -> eviction backoffs under load' + remediation steps.

josh: Also add a follow-up checklist: run `kubectl describe pod` sample, gather kubelet eviction logs, and confirm billing metrics post-rollback.

samir: If hotpatch fails, fallback is to pin top-level chart to snapshot 2.3.9 and re-schedule full regional promote during the 02:00 maintenance window.

Deploy-bot: deploybot: Hotpatch job queued by @maria -> job id hp-4910001245. Will attempt to update subchart reference and redeploy canary replicaSet.

leah: Approved HP. @maria go ahead. Notify release-council when hp finishes.

maria: Pushed PR #5129 with change and brief release note draft. Link: https://git.redwood/ops/helm/PR/5129

Deploy-bot: deploybot: Hotpatch hp-4910001245 started at 4910001260, steps: fetch chart, update dependencies, apply canary.

olivia: Copy of release note draft: 'Hotpatch: rollback billing subchart from 1.2.1 to 1.2.0 due to eviction backoffs in eu-west canary; fixed nodeSelector override in tenant overlay; follow-up: add stronger preflight for nodeSelector changes.'

josh: :thumbsup: Include the migration note for infra to check node pool autoscaler metrics.

Deploy-bot: deploybot: Hotpatch hp-4910001245 succeeded at 4910001278. Canary pods stabilized, evictions dropped to baseline. Promoting to canary resume?

leah: Resume canary if metrics stable for 10m. Let's wait until 4910001288 to confirm.

maria: 10m check passing. I will push canary resume.

Deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary resumed by @maria at 4910001289. Observed 0 new evictions in last 2m. Release notes updated and PR merged.

samir: Postmortem note: add guard in CI that scans values override diffs for `nodeSelector` and `replicas` in subcharts, block auto-promote if changed outside chart bump.

olivia: Filed ticket INFRA-1123 for the CI guard. Assigning to platform backlog.

josh: Thanks team. Upload short blurb to release-notes channel and tag infra.
